integrity: The count is exact; the infinite tail follows from Euler Bernoulli magnitudes, and finite certificates use exact rational arithmetic. Same-model review only; no independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only polar duals of symmetric edge polytopes of K_{2,q}, q>=1; does not classify ordinary Ehrhart positivity, roots, or K_{p,q} for p>=3. Earlier finite graph-polar table is expressly acknowledged. Historical originality has residual bibliographic risk.
title: The sharp magic-positivity threshold for polar complete-bipartite symmetric edge polytopes
